newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Apollo Group raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Apollo Group raised to buy.

text.p: --Chicago Corp said Wednesday it raised Apollo Group Inc to buy from hold, noting continued enrollment momentum, increased operating leverage and excellent revenue and earnings visability.
--Fiscal year 1996 estimate was raised to $0.41 a share from $0.40, while fiscal 1997 estimate was raised to $0.53 a share from $0.49, Chicago Corp said.
